#### [How to Reduce Cholesterol Naturally: Foods, Tips & When You Need Medicine][27]

High cholesterol has become one of India’s quiet epidemics. It rarely causes symptoms, yet it
silently raises your risk of heart attack and stroke, and many people only find out after a routine
blood test. The encouraging part? For a lot of people, cholesterol can be improved significantly
through everyday food and lifestyle changes. Here is how to lower it naturally, and when medicine
genuinely becomes necessary.

[Read More][28]

[[Vitamin D Deficiency: Symptoms, Normal Range, Causes & How to Fix It]][29]Medicines & Treatment
Guide

[Vamshikrishna Patel][30]July 24, 2026

#### [Vitamin D Deficiency: Symptoms, Normal Range, Causes & How to Fix It][31]

Vitamin D deficiency is one of the most common health problems in India, affecting a huge share of
people across cities and villages alike. The tricky part is that the signs are easy to miss:
constant tiredness, aching bones, low mood or hair fall get blamed on a busy life rather than a
simple, fixable nutrient gap. The good news is that low vitamin D is easy to test for and easy to
correct. Here are the warning symptoms, the normal range, and how to bring your levels back up.

[Read More][32]

[[Gastritis: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment & Best Medicines for Relief]][33]Medicines & Treatment
Guide

[Vamshikrishna Patel][34]July 24, 2026

#### [Gastritis: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment & Best Medicines for Relief][35]

That gnawing, burning pain in the upper stomach, the bloating after meals, the nausea that will not
settle: these are the classic signs of gastritis. It is one of the most common digestive complaints
in India, driven by our love of spicy food, irregular meals, stress and the habit of popping
painkillers. Gastritis means the lining of your stomach has become inflamed, and while it is usually
manageable, ignoring it can lead to bigger problems. Here is how to recognise it, treat it, and stop
it coming back.

### Frequently Asked Questions

##### [How does Medstown work?][18]

At Medstown, we connect patients searching for medicines by connecting them with local pharmacies.
When you place an order for your medicine through our app or website, we route it to your nearest
local pharmacy. Once your order is ready, our delivery team ensures it reaches your doorstep within
30 minutes.

##### [What are the advantages of choosing Medstown?][19]

We deliver Medicines from your nearby & also favourite pharmacy in just 30 mins at your doorstep

##### [How do you ensure the authenticity and quality of the medicines?][20]

We work exclusively with reputable and licensed local pharmacies only. This way, we make sure that
all the medicines reaching you through Medstown are sourced from genuine, reliable, authorised
suppliers and are of the best quality.

##### [Can I track the progress of my medicine delivery?][21]

Yes, once your order has been placed, you will receive all the tracking details on your registered
mobile number. This will help you in tracking your package in real time until the delivery partner
reaches your doorstep.

##### [What is the delivery time for my area?][22]

While Medstown’s commitment is to deliver your medicines within 30 minutes after your order is
confirmed, it is also important to note that the delivery time may get affected by factors such as
location and traffic. However, we assure you to deliver your medicines as quickly as possible.

#### [How to Reduce Cholesterol Naturally: Foods, Tips & When You Need Medicine][27]

High cholesterol has become one of India’s quiet epidemics. It rarely causes symptoms, yet it
silently raises your risk of heart attack and stroke, and many people only find out after a routine
blood test. The encouraging part? For a lot of people, cholesterol can be improved significantly
through everyday food and lifestyle changes. Here is how to lower it naturally, and when medicine
genuinely becomes necessary.

[Read More][28]

[[Vitamin D Deficiency: Symptoms, Normal Range, Causes & How to Fix It]][29]Medicines & Treatment
Guide

[Vamshikrishna Patel][30]July 24, 2026

#### [Vitamin D Deficiency: Symptoms, Normal Range, Causes & How to Fix It][31]

Vitamin D deficiency is one of the most common health problems in India, affecting a huge share of
people across cities and villages alike. The tricky part is that the signs are easy to miss:
constant tiredness, aching bones, low mood or hair fall get blamed on a busy life rather than a
simple, fixable nutrient gap. The good news is that low vitamin D is easy to test for and easy to
correct. Here are the warning symptoms, the normal range, and how to bring your levels back up.

[Read More][32]

[[Gastritis: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment & Best Medicines for Relief]][33]Medicines & Treatment
Guide

[Vamshikrishna Patel][34]July 24, 2026

#### [Gastritis: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment & Best Medicines for Relief][35]

That gnawing, burning pain in the upper stomach, the bloating after meals, the nausea that will not
settle: these are the classic signs of gastritis. It is one of the most common digestive complaints
in India, driven by our love of spicy food, irregular meals, stress and the habit of popping
painkillers. Gastritis means the lining of your stomach has become inflamed, and while it is usually
manageable, ignoring it can lead to bigger problems. Here is how to recognise it, treat it, and stop
it coming back.

### Partners & Supporters

Connect with us © No Lights, No Lycra 2026
We acknowledge the Traditional Custodians of the lands on which No Lights No Lycra is located and
where we conduct our business. We pay our respects to Elders, past and present. No Lights No Lycra
is committed to honouring Indigenous peoples’ unique cultural and spiritual relationships to the
land, waters and seas and their rich contribution to society.

### **Acknowledgement of Country**

 

**No Lights No Lycra respectfully acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the land on which our
No Lights No Lycra events are located.**

No Lights No Lycra is based on the lands of the Wurundjeri People of the Kulin Nation, in Narrm
(Melbourne). We pay our deepest respects to Aboriginal communities of the Kulin Nation,
acknowledging Elders, past and present.

No Lights No Lycra honours the continued connection and communication to land and waterways of
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Nations through dance and song. We acknowledge the ongoing
leadership of Aboriginal communities, and their practice of holistic education supporting the mental
health and wellbeing of young people through artistic and cultural self- expression.

We pay respect to the cultures, knowledge and continued history of all Aboriginal and Torres Strait
Islander Nations, uniting learning, knowledge exchange, culture, connection and wellbeing.

news, and more.

company status.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who are the experts reading ECGs on the Qaly app?**

On the Qaly app, certified cardiographic technicians [read your ECG][34].
‍

Cardiographic technicians are health professionals — like cardiac nurses — who study how to read
abnormal heart rhythms from ECGs in hospitals. These cardiographic technicians are trained to
identify irregularities like [SVT][35], [AFib][36], [PVCs][37], [PACs][38], [Short PR Interval][39],
[Inconclusive ECGs][40], and more.

Now, on the Qaly app, these same technicians read ECGs from your smartwatch or at-home ECG device,
24/7, whenever you need them to.

Most importantly, all cardiographic technicians on Qaly have successfully cleared the CCT exam
administered by Cardiovascular Credentialing International, which is considered the gold-standard in
heart rhythm analysis credentialing for cardiographic technicians.

**What rhythms do experts on the Qaly app look for?**

On the Qaly app, certified cardiographic technicians monitor your ECGs for 33 different abnormal
heart rhythms, or arrhythmias:

• [Complete Heart Block][41]
• [Ventricular Tachycardia (Sustained)][42]
• [Second Degree AV Block Type 2][43]
• [Sinus Pause >3 Seconds][44]

# Shape the Future of Rare Disease at NORD's Breakthrough Summit®

**Washington, D.C. | October 25-27, 2026**

Register now for the NORD® Rare Diseases & Orphan Products Breakthrough Summit® — the leading event
for rare disease advocates, industry leaders, researchers, and policymakers.

[Register Today][246]
[NORD Summit Hero Image]

#### [Understanding New Medicaid Requirements][247]

Starting in 2027, community engagement or work requirements will apply to some Medicaid enrollees.
NORD has explainers for patients and caregivers, plus recommendations for state and federal
policymakers.

[LEARN MORE][248]

#### [Your Experience Can Shape the Future][249]

The Living Rare Study® is the first large-scale, long-term U.S. study tracking the evolving
experiences of individuals and caregivers impacted by rare diseases. Sharing your story can help
shape NORD programming, inform policy decisions, and improve access to resources that enhance
quality of life.

[JOIN THE STUDY][250]

#### [Rare Science on Demand][251]

Missed NORD's Rare Disease Scientific Symposium? Explore expert presentations, breakthrough
insights, and key research and regulatory discussions shaping the future of rare disease.

[ACCESS NOW][252]

][253]

RareCare® programs.

[Get support][254]

[Search now][256]

][257]

patients.

[Learn More][258]

# Shape the Future of Rare Disease at NORD's Breakthrough Summit®

**Washington, D.C. | October 25-27, 2026**

Register now for the NORD® Rare Diseases & Orphan Products Breakthrough Summit® — the leading event
for rare disease advocates, industry leaders, researchers, and policymakers.

[Register Today][246]
[NORD Summit Hero Image]

#### [Understanding New Medicaid Requirements][247]

Starting in 2027, community engagement or work requirements will apply to some Medicaid enrollees.
NORD has explainers for patients and caregivers, plus recommendations for state and federal
policymakers.

[LEARN MORE][248]

#### [Your Experience Can Shape the Future][249]

The Living Rare Study® is the first large-scale, long-term U.S. study tracking the evolving
experiences of individuals and caregivers impacted by rare diseases. Sharing your story can help
shape NORD programming, inform policy decisions, and improve access to resources that enhance
quality of life.

[JOIN THE STUDY][250]

insights, and key research and regulatory discussions shaping the future of rare disease.

### Step 3: Study smarter and ace your exams

Review with spaced repetition flashcards, take AI-generated practice tests, and track your weak

Get step-by-step homework help, auto-generated study notes, flashcards, and practice quizzes for any

Prepare for NCLEX, CPA, PMP, and other certification exams with AI-powered practice questions and
study materials. Paraphrase and polish reports, proposals, and professional documents with AI

What is StudyX? expand_more
StudyX is an all-in-one AI study platform designed to help students learn more effectively. It
combines AI study tools such as homework help, notes generation, flashcards, quizzes, and writing
support in one place.
How does StudyX help students study with AI? expand_more
StudyX helps students study with AI throughout the entire learning journey. Students can use it to
get homework help, turn lectures and study materials into notes, generate flashcards and quizzes for
exam preparation, and improve writing with AI-powered tools. By combining multiple AI study tools in
one platform, StudyX supports different learning needs—from daily homework and classroom learning to
exam prep and professional training—making it useful for students of all ages and learning stages.
What subjects can StudyX's AI study tools help with? expand_more

solve problems and generate study materials across different topics.
Is StudyX a free AI study platform? expand_more

choose StudyX's cost-friendly subscription plans.
What is the best AI study tool for students? expand_more

what they learn. StudyX combines homework help, AI notes, flashcards, quizzes, and writing tools in
one AI study platform, making it easier for students to study more efficiently. Besides StudyX,

Can AI tools help with exam preparation? expand_more
AI study tools such as StudyX can support exam preparation by generating practice quizzes,
summarizing key topics, and creating flashcards from study materials. These features help students
review information and reinforce what they have learned before tests.
Are AI study tools suitable for all ages? expand_more
AI study platforms like StudyX are designed to support students across different learning stages,
from middle school and high school to university and professional training. Tools like StudyX can
adapt to different subjects, learning levels, and study goals.

  [Sesame logo]
  
  Sesame offers personal care for telehealth patients. Doctors are local to you and you’re able to
  schedule a visit in-person or virtually–whichever fits your schedule best.
  
  [Learn More][34]

  [BetterHelp logo]
  
  BetterHelp connects patients with reputable mental health professionals through secure phone,
  video, or live chat sessions for professional and convenient mental and behavioral health therapy.
  As a BetterHelp affiliate, we may receive compensation from BetterHelp if you purchase products or
  services through the links provided.

  [Hims logo]
  
  Hims is an online health provider dedicated to helping men with various issues. Whether you’re
  hoping to lose weight, reduce your anxiety, improve your sexual performance, or regrow your hair,
  Hims is here to help. In-person visits are not required – you’ll receive all the assistance and
  support you need through the Hims app.
  
  [Learn More][36]

resources are backed by experts with tens of thousands of hours of experience in the field of
telehealth.

  [Telehealth During COVID-19]
  
  COVID-19 has forever changed the way we receive health care – forcing us to find more convenient
  and safe methods of receiving health care.

  [Telehealth Nursing]
  
  Telehealth nursing allows nurses to carry out many of their responsibilities virtually. It can be
  used to streamline or automate processes, giving nurses more time for clinical work that can only
  be performed in person.
  
  [Read More ][38]

  [Read More ][39]
